name: Overpass API (OpenStreetMap query)
summary: Read-only query language API to extract any OpenStreetMap features by tag, area or bounding box.
description: Run Overpass QL queries to fetch nodes, ways and relations with tags and geometry, for example all cafes in a bounding box, roads, boundaries or amenities. Output as JSON, XML or CSV; supports 'out geom' for full geometry and area filters.

auth.notes: No key; send a descriptive User-Agent (requests without one returned 406).

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Requests without a User-Agent returned HTTP 406.

rate_limit.summary: Fair use: about 10,000 queries/day and 1 GB/day per server suggested; slots limit concurrent queries (see /api/status).

endpoints.summary: Run an Overpass QL query (form-encoded data parameter)

agent_notes: Send the query as form field data=<Overpass QL>. Set [out:json] and [timeout:N], keep bounding boxes small (south,west,north,east order), and send a User-Agent.
caveats: Overpass QL has a learning curve.
CORS was not re-checked at curation time (status endpoint timed out); research reported it as supported.
